items.title_kr: Macy's, Thanksgiving Day Parade 기념 exclusive Disney Capsule Collection 출시
items.title_en: Disney and Macy's Drop Thanksgiving Parade Collection Ahead of Holiday Season
items.body_kr: Macy's가 Thanksgiving Day Parade 100주년을 맞아 exclusive Disney Capsule Collection과 Holiday merchandise를 공개하며 offline store 판매에 돌입했습니다. Holiday merchandise sourcing 및 Collaboration category 기획 시 벤더사들의 적극적인 레퍼런스 활용이 요구됩니다.
items.body_en: Macy's launched an exclusive Disney Capsule Collection and holiday merchandise in stores celebrating the Thanksgiving Day Parade. Vendors should note this major retail collaboration as a benchmark for holiday season capsule strategies.

items.title_en: Can Abercrombie's Target Partnership Fuel Hollister's Growth?
items.body_kr: Market analysts are evaluating how Abercrombie's strategic retail partnership can further accelerate Hollister's growth trajectory. Apparel vendors expanding wholesale channels should closely track these brand positioning dynamics.

items.title_kr: S&P Global Ratings, Macy's credit outlook 수정… 주가 안정세 유지
items.title_en: S&P Global Ratings Revises Macy's Outlook Amid Market Fluctuations
items.body_kr: S&P Global Ratings has revised Macy's outlook, drawing attention to department store financial health. Vendor sales teams must monitor major retail credit and earnings guidance to assess inventory order stability.

items.title_kr: Greg Lutzka, 키즈 스케이팅 category 진입 위한 signature collection 출시
items.title_en: Greg Lutzka Launches Signature Collection at Kohl’s for Kids
items.body_kr: Kohl's introduced an affordable signature kids' skating and activewear collection in partnership with Greg Lutzka. This launch serves as a strong pricing and category expansion reference for children's activewear vendors.

items.title_kr: Levi Strauss, 관세 환급 및 전략적 expansion 힘입어 full-year earnings outlook 상향
items.title_en: Levi Strauss Lifts Full-Year Earnings Outlook Following Tariff Refunds and Expansion
items.body_kr: Levi Strauss raised its full-year earnings outlook backed by tariff refunds and strategic retail expansion. This denim market momentum provides positive margin and sourcing insights for apparel vendor teams.
